headline: Google DeepMind launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen for faster coding

items.text:
Google DeepMind launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen for faster coding

• Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast, cost-effective model for coding and multi-model workflows.
• The filing also reports a 15% Adjusted Operating Margin and a net loss of $23.3 billion, largely due to a non-cash charge.
• Nvidia’s founder Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO amid scandal, and CFO Colette Kress was named interim chief executive.

Full five-minute read, every claim sourced: link in bio (fiveminuteai.net)
